title: Cloudflare Clef 27B on SGLang (Docker, full BF16)
slug_note: The card's own serving path: SGLang's clef image on a big GPU.

engine.config: lmsysorg/sglang:dev-clef image, sglang serve on port 30000

requirements.notes: Estimate: 55 GB BF16 weights plus KV; needs an 80 GB-class GPU or 128 GB unified memory.

run.command: docker run --gpus all --shm-size 32g -p 30000:30000 -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface --ipc=host lmsysorg/sglang:dev-clef sglang serve --model-path Cloudflare/clef --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000

steps.text: Install Docker with NVIDIA GPU support.

docker run --gpus all --shm-size 32g -p 30000:30000 -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface --ipc=host lmsysorg/sglang:dev-clef sglang serve --model-path Cloudflare/clef --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000
Send decision requests to http://localhost:30000/v1/systemone with model "Cloudflare/clef".

caveats: Decision model: it answers typed questions with probabilities on /v1/systemone; it does not chat, so OpenCode and chat UIs cannot use it.
The image tag is a dev build (dev-clef); pin a digest for anything you depend on.
